outcomes.outcome: a per-title rsnapshot configuration, 0644 root:root, rendered from the parameters and accepted by rsnapshot
root's crontab runs `rsnapshot -c <conf> daily` at 23:00, which rsyncs the backup point into the snapshot root
a run takes a daily snapshot holding a byte-identical copy of the backup point, so its files can be restored from there
retention keeps exactly ndays daily snapshots, rotating the oldest away

uncovered.why: a run would have to wait for 23:00; the crontab entry is checked and its exact command is run by hand
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a wall-clock trigger in phase3.py runs (waiting for, or shifting, the node's time)
uncovered.evidence: clock_check.py (HQ 2026-11-17 batch-8 ruling 4) requires every lab clock to agree with the laptop's, and phase3.py has no step that waits for a time of day
